data.one_liner: A fully customizable side menu widget for Flutter navigation and filters.
data.what_it_does: Provides a side menu widget with adjustable width, resizer, toggle, headers, footers, and item tiles. Can be used for directory navigation, filtering options, or custom side panels.
use_when: You need a responsive side navigation menu for desktop, web, or mobile applications.
You want resizable or collapsible side panels with custom headers and footers.
avoid_when: You require a standard top-level navigation drawer (Drawer widget) without resizing features.
You are building a purely backend or non-UI service.
strengths: Fully customizable layout including headers, footers, and item tiles
Built-in resizer and resizer toggle support
Supports both left and right side placement
weaknesses: Limited to side menu use cases
Does not handle routing logic out of the box (requires manual implementation)
data.minimal_example:
SideMenu(
  builder: (data) => SideMenuData(
    header: const Text('Header'),
    items: [
      SideMenuItemDataTile(
        isSelected: true,
        onTap: () {},
        title: 'Item 1',
        icon: const Icon(Icons.home),
      ),
    ],
    footer: const Text('Footer'),
  ),
)
